source_identity.title: Towards a Standard for Identifying and Managing Bias in Artificial Intelligence

scope: All 14 canonical records, with exact primary-text comparison focused on Sections 2.1, 3.1.2, 3.2.2, 3.3.2 and 3.4.1 represented by the catalogue.
excluded_material: Unrepresented explanatory examples, roadmap material and non-operative framing were not promoted into new EXTREQ records.
No Fidelity Class relationships, Incident findings or new taxonomy categories were created.
unresolved_issues: The publication is preliminary voluntary guidance and does not establish a complete bias-management procedure.
Fairness, representativeness and institutional-capacity concepts remain outside or contextual to the current neutral taxonomy.
AI review is not human verification; assurance is limited to the represented extraction scope.
